main.description: Partially update the mutable settings of a registered Gyoka feed. Only the provided optional fields are updated; omitted fields retain their current values. At least one optional field must be provided.

uri.description: AT-URI of the feed generator record to update.

langFilter.description: Whether language filtering is enabled for the feed.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: Returned when service authentication is required and the caller is not authenticated.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Returned when the authenticated caller is not in the admin allowlist.

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.description: Returned when the request payload is invalid or contains no fields to update.

errors.name: UnknownFeed
errors.description: Returned when the target feed URI is not registered.

errors.name: InternalServerError
errors.description: Returned when the feed cannot be updated.
